proves.claim: policyProblems takes two path maps and the candidate root; a plan shard order, root or front door change raises no problem while a disappeared accepted path-map row still does.

cli.io-cells-submit-checks.plan-identity.why: Without it, a regression that reads the plan again would refuse items for plan identity edits, or a plan-free policy could drop the path-map row guard.

proves.claim: A new import through a compatibility shim is refused when the shim owners are built from the path maps, and an import of the moved module is accepted.

cli.io-cells-submit-checks.a-new-import-.why: Without it, dropping the plan would silently disable the shim ratchet.
